description: Land Acquisition - Chankanai East, Valikamam West D/S Division, Jaffna District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed information about specific land parcels being acquired for public purpose, including location details (village, DS division, district, province), lot numbers, land descriptions, and procedures for claiming compensation. This falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) as it deals with land acquisition matters.
